description: Per-wave story battle setup: allied MissionCharacter rows, playable-character slot, generic wave id and battle-talk sets.

ID.simple: Story mission wave row id, normally the mission id.
ID.technical: FName key in StoryMissionWaveDataTables (DTM +0x8E0), reached via StoryMission.Id_StoryMissionWave[WaveIndex]. Exported rows are mostly named after their mission, with one row per wave variant; the row is cached on the battle task system as StoryMissionWave / StoryMissionWaves.

Id_MissionCharacter_Ally.simple: Allied MissionCharacter rows taking part in this wave.
Id_MissionCharacter_Ally.technical: TArray<FName> (three exported slots). None entries are skipped when filtering for the playable-character count, when inserting the playable ally at the front of a wave's list, and when deduplicating across waves. The launch path indexes the array by PlayableCharacterIndex to set the player's battle character slot.

PlayableCharacterIndex.simple: Index in Id_MissionCharacter_Ally that the player controls.
PlayableCharacterIndex.technical: int32 (row +0x20), constructor default 0; exported values are -2, -1, 0 and 1. If > -1 it is returned directly by Story_GetPlayableCharacterIndex. Otherwise a single non-None ally yields 0 and zero/multiple allies yield -1. Story_HasPlayableCharacterIndex tests > -2, and Story_GetBattleLayout treats <= -2 as a single ally for layout purposes. The launch path uses the value to index the ally array without another bounds check.

Id_MissionWave.simple: Generic MissionWave row for enemy/order data.
Id_MissionWave.technical: FName (row +0x24). Story_GetBattleLayout and Story_GetDemoMissionTask resolve it in MissionWaveDataTables (DTM +0x9A0), from which enemy ids, mission-task lottery and mission order are read; a missing row returns 255/no task or aborts that lookup.

Id_BattleTalkSet.simple: Battle-talk sets attached to this wave.
Id_BattleTalkSet.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x30, ten exported slots). The current wave's array is walked in the story battle fight state: unconditional sets (all ValueType None) are queued on entry, and conditional sets are queued once each when their conditions hold. Battle-story phase helpers also resolve the sets to preload cue sheets and battle-talk lines; None ids are skipped.

notes: PlayableCharacterIndex -2 is exported but is not a documented distinct semantic: it is treated as 'no explicit playable index' by the same branches as -1 (Story_HasPlayableCharacterIndex false; layout falls back to one ally).
All four exported arrays/slots are used positionally; None is the empty sentinel rather than shortening the array.
93 exported rows; no numbered shards or localization variants found.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Story_GetPlayableCharacterIndex resolves the mission's first wave and its playable ally index.
Collects ally MissionCharacter rows across waves, putting the playable one first.
Battle layout lookup from wave allies and the linked MissionWave's enemies.
Mission-task lookup walks StoryMissionWave -> MissionWave -> MissionTaskLottery.
Queues wave battle talks in the fight state.
Preloads battle-talk cue sheets and lines for the wave.
Fills the player's battle character slot from the wave's playable ally.
